protocol: error-rate-protocol.md, fifth amendment point 5 and tenth amendment; re-run on the current fit by this manifest step (review of 29 September 2026, M-3); since 13 October 2026 its rate is draw four's and its read set holds draw four's records (error-rate-protocol-fourth.md, 'What happens to the propagation')

fit.note: the fit this simulation ran on; the archive's own runs record theirs

rate_population.same_population_reason: the study's run id is a full run id of an earlier definition and the current one is calibration-free, so they cannot be compared; n_in_current_working_sample and n_left_current_working_sample say how far the populations differ
rate_population.note: the study's rate (A_sampled) is the rate of the working sample it drew from; the records still in the current working sample are counted beside it with their historical verdicts, on the figures their readings scored: a post-selection subset of the draw, not a sample of the current working sample, and not restated on the figures adopted now (rate_population_on_primary does that)

frame_against_primary.rule: simulation-frame classification: the study's read set less records whose adopted figure changed after reading, plus changed records covered by a mature-cohort source reading of kind reading or error_rate_study (including figures derived from read source cells), or by a sampled record's direct recomputation or confirmed-figure register reading of its current figure. Mature source-reading coverage does not require a reading to give the adopted figure directly; current-figure reconciliation does.

rate_population_on_primary.note: each sampled population reconciled with the figures adopted now (restated_population): every record in the working sample with the figure its reading scored and the figure adopted now, on every route; an unchanged figure keeps its verdict, a changed one is scored only on a reading of the current figure (verdict_on_current) or left not restated. A reconciliation, not a rate for the current working sample; the rates the propagation applies are the protocol's, unchanged

operator_construction: size-only operator: gamma fixed at 0 in the likelihood (the headline fit); a refit, not a zeroing: k, sigma_undiv, sigma_div, nu_clean and nu_RITC are that fit's own posterior. sigma does not depend on H, so the concentration channel of any decomposition is exactly zero

shift_model_relative_change.note: the shift model is the one built from the errors actually confirmed

overlay_sensitivity.operator_construction: concentration overlay: the gamma-free fit, its fitted concentration exponent gamma (each posterior draw, or the posterior mean) and its own k, sigma_undiv, sigma_div and nu; a labelled sensitivity, not the headline

shift_model_relative_change.note: the shift model is the one built from the errors actually confirmed

pooled_rate_sensitivity.note: the pooled rate of the second and third samples, run beside draw four's with the same seed, replicates and unread records (the fourth protocol); never pooled with draw four
